d01-udah-stimulasi.note: Reassurance angle lifts it; still a familiar topic, so the hook does the work.

d02-potong-makanan.note: Strongest forward-to-caregiver post; kelengkeng covered without exploiting the news.

d03-mainan-dari-dapur.note: Cooking situation makes it savable; points are still a standard list.

d04-mitos-bayi.note: Built for the family WA group; gentle to elders.

d05-keluhan-suami.note: Self-roast fixes the backfire risk; check the 'Hmm' slide reads as a joke, not a dig.

d06-main-pas-hujan.note: Post only if it actually rains that week; otherwise swap with d10.

d07-suami-bisa-bantu.note: Non-obvious tasks (pos menyusui, grup WA) make it worth tagging.

d08-tummy-time.note: Useful but niche; saves more than shares. Fine as a weekday filler.

d09-protein-hewani.note: Hook is a correction, not a moment; consider 'Udah 7 bulan tapi lauknya masih jarang?'

d10-rotasi-mainan.note: Money angle helps; topic itself is common.

d11-siap-sekolah.note: Policy fact verified; calms calistung panic. Strongest again in Jan to Jun.

d12-nggak-apa-apa.note: Tag engine with empathy; keep the husband as learner, never villain.

d13-motorik-halus.note: 'Jangan buru-buru les nulis' gives it a stance; later bridge to Momo worksheets.

d14-gtm.note: Comment post on the top pain point; IDAI feeding rules keep it safe.

s01-stiker-wa.note: Now a send post: the pack is literally made to forward to a partner. Link is typed, not clickable, so expect some drop-off.

d31-tujuh-indra.note: '7 indra, bukan 5' is a belief-flip hook; pyramid is our own drawing, framed as a model. Trust held at 4 because the topic sits next to contested therapy claims.

d25-ternyata-normal.note: Relief angle for a daily mess moment; send target is the partner or whoever feeds the baby.

d16-protein-pasar.note: Contrarian 'nggak perlu salmon' hook; still close to d09, the weekly rotation is the new value.

d17-main-5-menit.note: Very doable; common topic, illustrations carry it.

w2e-d21-kirim-pengasuh.note: Clear forward-to-pengasuh job; grape and 'bukan salah Nenek' angles repeat d02 and d04, so freshness is the weak point.

w2e-d22-jawaban-sopan.note: Kind to family and points to KMS instead of arguing; the hook sentence is a bit long to read in one glance.

w2e-d27-buku-per-usia.note: Per-age guide is very savable; 'boleh digigit' is the surprise, the rest is a familiar list.

w2e-d29-belum-ngomong.note: Worrying topic by nature; calm framing and the home slide help, but relief stays moderate.

w2e-d23-alat-mpasi.note: Strong myth-busting hook; the send recipient (pasangan before checkout) is plausible, not certain.

w2e-d24-mainan-banyak-cara.note: Natural follow-up to d10; open-ended play is a common topic, so freshness rests on the kardus hook.

w2e-d15-screen-time.note: Reassuring hook; the video-call exception comes from AAP and Buku KIA, not WHO, and the slide says so.

w2n-30-menit-malam.note: Real working-mom comment as the peg; 'udah berarti' is reassurance, not a promise. Weakest: research line is about caregivers, not the 30 minutes.

w2n-gigi-pertama.note: Myth-bust hook carries it; body is a plain checklist. Fluoride for babies may surprise parents used to non-fluoride baby paste.

w2n-tanda-kenyang.note: Reframes GTM as a fullness cue; GTM topic did poorly before (212 views) but that hook was a bare question.

w2n-tidur-aman.note: Clear send target (pasangan/pengasuh); safe sleep is saturated and co-sleeping is common, so the CTA stays gentle.

w2n-nangis-malam.note: Permission to put the baby down is the unexpected part; shaking warning stated once, gently, per AAP.

w2n-porsi-mpasi.note: Classic save chart; '2-3 sendok itu normal' gives the relief angle. Portion table is Kemenkes, not IDAI.

w2n-demam-kapan-dokter.note: Most useful save of the week but the hook is a principle, not a surprise. No medicine names or doses.

w2e-d32-bantu-beresin.note: New topic for the account; research hook kept honest (kicker KATA RISET, sub 'cenderung, bukan jaminan', slide 2 names the study and its limits). Hook is a flat statement, but 3 short lines lean on the hero art.

w3e-s01-jangan-nangis.note: First story-format post (structure studied from omonganibu, own topic and art): scene, confession hook, child's view, 3 steps with exact words, quotable close, kirim ke pasangan. New family characters (Mama, Ayah, Adek). Dad slips, then redeems himself.

w3e-adhd.note: Relief hook with a concrete age; the send target (grup WA keluarga) is implied, not named on a slide.

w3e-newborn-skip.note: Gurita and baby walker repeat d04 mitos-bayi; the shopping-list angle is what makes it new.

w3e-mitos-2.note: Sequel of a proven format, so less fresh; hook relies on named objects plus the d04 promise.

w3e-kata-pertama.note: Reassuring reframe of babbling, IDAI+CDC aligned and points back to the 5 Nov red flags; speech stages are a common topic, freshness comes from one action per stage.

w3e-main-nunggu-masak.note: Named objects in the hook (lakban kertas, kulkas) and a fresh set vs d03; kitchen play itself is a familiar topic and Tunas scenes are small on slide 2.

w3e-jawaban-sopan-2.note: Bau tangan myth-bust hook in the 'bukan salah Nenek' tone; send-to-pasangan is plausible but the strongest share (to family WA) is deliberately avoided so relatives are not shamed.

w3n-ngobrol.note: Keeps the 'ketik MAU' promise, so the save is built in; hook is reassurance with a concrete chore, not a surprise fact. Serve-and-return itself is a common topic.

w3n-gigi-telat.note: Answers a real viewer question with relief; 'bisa normal' is hedged on purpose. Sources differ on when to check (MedlinePlus says 9 months), so we point to the 1-year dental visit instead of a number.

w3n-kaki-o.note: Kemenkes calls bedong-biar-lurus a myth, a natural forward to the family group; risk is that it reads as correcting the elders, so the CTA says bukan salah siapa-siapa.

w3n-ruam-popok.note: Bedak is the everyday Indonesian reflex, so the myth flip lands; ruam popok itself is a saturated topic told as a plain 4-step list.

w3n-kepala-peyang.note: Relief hook (not the brain) plus the bantal peyang warning; may draw pushback from parents who already bought one, keep replies gentle.

w3n-cegukan.note: Startling is more an adult trick than a baby one, so the hook is weaker; no primary source calls the old tricks harmful, so the copy only says nggak perlu.

w3n-air-putih.note: Clear send to nenek or pengasuh, framed kindly; the message is well known from IDAI campaigns, the hot-weather angle is the fresh part.

w3e-gelar-dokter-anak.note: Pure save utility, already fact-checked; weakest is relief: it informs more than it reassures, CTA leans on 'cukup ke Sp.A dulu' to calm.

w3n-asip-simpan.note: Myth-flip with a number like gigi pertama; caregivers handle the stock so the send is real. Relief is only the CTA line.

w4s-wake-window.note: Concrete newborn fact (feeding counts as awake time) but not a myth-buster; 12-18 month row has no published range, so it says '3 jam lebih' and the slide labels every number 'kisaran kasar'.

w4s-jam-tidur.note: Jam 8 corrects late bedtimes with a number, but parents of 10 pm sleepers may feel judged (CTA softens it); bedtimes are our arithmetic from SCHN/AASM, and the baby row gives no clock time.

w4s-growth-spurt.note: Hits the commonest ASI-kurang worry head on; the hook is absolute on its own, so the sub line and wet-diaper note carry the safety limit.

w4l-asi-naik.note: Hook reframes the katuk habit warmly with a concrete answer, but 'how to boost ASI' is a saturated topic; the save comes from the 5-row cheat.

w4l-mastitis.note: Myth-correcting hook (no urut) backed by the 2022 ABM protocol, which most Indonesian content still contradicts; risk is that 'nggak perlu diurut' clashes with what bidan or family advise, so the copy names the source.

w4l-overstimulasi.note: Hook says 'dia minta jeda' flatly although cues are 'bisa jadi'; the slides soften it. Comment ask is easy (one word).

w4l-finger-food.note: Finger food is a crowded topic; the gagging-vs-tersedak hook is the fresh part. 'Gagging' is code-mix some moms may not know.

w4l-kakak-adik.note: Relief hook against the 'kakak harus langsung sayang' norm, but no number; audience is only parents expecting a second child.

w4l-ayah-main.note: Research is correlational (softened on slide 01); 'latihan sabar' is a framing, and the ayah series has underperformed whatever the hook.

w4l-s02-tantrum-minimarket.note: Tantrum is a saturated topic; the minimarket-kasir scene and the no-judgement 3-way comment question carry it.

w4s-susu-uht.note: Concrete limit flips 'makin banyak makin bagus', but most of our audience is under 12 months, so the save is for later and relief is only the CTA line.

w4s-asip-ml.note: Strong save for return-to-work moms; the 30 ml per jam rule is our own arithmetic from HSE's 750 ml a day, shown as such on the slide.

w4s-kolik.note: Relief hook with a date to hold on to; kolik itself is saturated, the tag-team angle for the partner is the fresh part.

w4s-gula.note: 6 sendok teh is concrete but familiar to some parents; no product numbers on slides (none primary-sourced), so the label maths carries it.
